contract_metadata.title: GSI Aeromagnetic & Geological Vector Ingestion Contract Specification

aeromagnetic_grid_contract.dataset: GSI National Aero-geophysical Mapping Program (NAGMP) HRAS

resampling_to_study_grid.documentation: Continuous field resampling with documented native 50m resolution

mandatory_survey_parameters.magnetometer: Cesium Vapor Magnetometer (sensitivity 0.001 nT, rate 10 Hz)

rejection_triggers: Any raster marked as synthetic, simulated, or interpolated from distant stations
Rasters derived from uncalibrated browser screen captures of WMS viewers
Missing flight altitude or line spacing metadata

mandatory_layers.critical_role: Mandatory exclusion mask to prevent false-positive magnetic high classifications from titanomagnetite-bearing mafic dykes

rejection_triggers: Vector layers digitized by tracing low-resolution unreferenced raster maps
Missing attribute tables with formational names

validation_workflow_upon_data_arrival: Step 1: Checksum verification (SHA-256) and file integrity check
Step 2: Coordinate reference system transform to EPSG:32645
Step 3: Boundary clipping to Singhbhum Iron Ore Craton study envelope (Lat 21.60-22.60, Lon 85.05-86.15)
Step 4: Dolerite dyke exclusion masking applied to aeromagnetic TMI highs
Step 5: Leave-One-Deposit-Out spatial cross-validation evaluation across the 5 confirmed mines
Step 6: Only if spatially blocked F1 > 0.65 and ROC-AUC > 0.75 across unseen deposits, evaluate model deployment criteria
